56 (B) State board, commission, agency, department, or board; or
57 (C) Other form of government.
58 (2) 'Policy' means an ordinance, resolution, regulation, code, or any other requirement
59 imposed by a governmental entity.
60 (b) No governmental entity of this state shall adopt any policy that restricts or prohibits,
61 or has the effect of restricting or prohibiting, based on the type or source of energy or fuel
62 to be delivered or the appliance to be used:
63 (1) The connection or reconnection of a customer to an electric utility, gas company, or
64 natural, manufactured, or liquefied petroleum gas service;
65 (2) Sales of liquefied petroleum gas, including, but not limited to, directly to a consumer
66 by a retail establishment; or
